title: ID0462451-DC/Si-D/BE-[MP / R4 170001620] Fault after FW update
description:
Reported behaviour/issue: Both plugs show status "Faulted" after firmware update. Soft reboot through SCB does not resolve the issue .
Solution: Yes ( There was an internal misconfiguration).
